overview: Asthma is a chronic respiratory condition characterized by airway inflammation and narrowing, causing recurrent episodes of wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness, and coughing.

types.name: Allergic Asthma
types.description: Triggered by allergens like pollen, dust mites, pet dander, mold.

types.name: Non-Allergic Asthma
types.description: Triggered by exercise, cold air, stress, infections, or irritants.

types.name: Occupational Asthma
types.description: Caused by workplace irritants like chemicals, dust, or fumes.

types.name: Exercise-Induced Asthma
types.description: Symptoms appear during or after physical exertion.

symptoms: Coughing (especially at night or early morning)
risk_factors: Family history of asthma or allergies

long_term_control: Biologics for severe asthma: Omalizumab, Mepolizumab
lifestyle: Avoid outdoor activities on high-pollen days

emergency_signs: No improvement after using rescue inhaler

faqs.question: Can asthma go away on its own?
faqs.answer: Some children outgrow asthma, but many carry it into adulthood. It can be well-controlled but rarely fully cured.

faqs.question: Can I exercise with asthma?
faqs.answer: Yes. With proper medication and warm-up, most asthmatics can exercise safely. Use a rescue inhaler before exercise if recommended.
